summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Companhia Paranaense de Energia (COPEL), a Brazilian electric utility. The filing reports minutes of the 273rd Ordinary Board of Directors meeting held April 15, 2026. Key decisions include approval of a R$706 million distribution of Interest on Equity (a form of dividend) with a record date of April 29, 2026 and payment on September 30, 2026, and approval of the annual Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025. No special situation transaction is involved.
